breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the conflicting time-integration instructions. The ground truth removed the incorrect "Explicit forward Euler" method and kept the more detailed "Deterministic IMEX" method. The agent incorrectly merged the two conflicting instructions into "Explicit forward Euler with deterministic IMEX (1st order)", which is not a standard or correct description and fails to resolve the ambiguity as specified by the ground truth.
